name: Neutral
character: A pure grayscale spine. The accent is ink, not a colour, so nothing on the page competes with the content.
use: Documentation, dashboards, anything where the interface should disappear.
upstreamDescription: Restrained warm grays. Minimal and quiet, so the content stays the focus.

name: Butter
character: Cream paper with one vivid blue. The only theme whose accent really shouts.
use: Marketing pages and product launches that want a single confident colour.
upstreamDescription: Warm, creamy yellows with a friendly blue accent. Playful enough for consumer surfaces, soft enough to stay readable.

name: Chocolate
character: Warm browns with a serif for headings — the only theme that mixes two type families of different species.
use: Editorial writing, long reads, anything with a printed feel.
upstreamDescription: Warm chocolate theme for Astryx — rich brown palette with Fraunces headings, Albert Sans body, and Lucide icons

name: Matcha
character: Deep green on paper, headings set in a handwriting face, and the softest corners in the set.
use: Craft, food, wellbeing — places where a human hand should show.
upstreamDescription: Earthy greens with a calm, organic feel. Naturalistic and grounded, great for wellness or content-first apps.

name: Stone
character: Cool grey with Montserrat headings over a Figtree body. Quiet and architectural.
use: Corporate and professional-services sites that want restraint.
upstreamDescription: Warm stone and slate, earthy and understated, with just enough character to feel handcrafted.

name: Gothic
character: Dark even in light mode — the one theme that does not flip. Near-white on near-black at every hour.
upstreamDescription: Deep blue-grays and a signature display serif. Dramatic and editorial, for surfaces that want to be remembered.

name: Y2K
character: Lavender canvas and square corners: radius zero, the only theme with no rounding at all.
use: Playful, retro-leaning brands that want to look deliberately unsoftened.
upstreamDescription: Hot pinks, lime greens, and Poppins. Bubbly, playful, and unmistakably retro.
